note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. The episode is copied to a neutral folder C:\lab\plNN so no user name shows in paths.
prepare: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null
Remove-Item C:\lab\pl08 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Copy-Item -Path (Get-Location).Path -Destination C:\lab\pl08 -Recurse -Force
if (-not (py -3.13 --version 2>$null)) { winget install --id Python.Python.3.13 -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements }
py -3.13 -m venv C:\lab\pl08\.venv
& C:\lab\pl08\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -q -e 'C:\lab\pl08[dev]'
# owner signs in (device code) only if there is no session yet, and selects the lab subscription (az account set); never typed on camera
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }
az group create -n rg-mglab-code-08 -l westeurope -o none
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
$sa = az storage account list -g rg-mglab-code-08 --query "[0].name" -o tsv; if (-not $sa) { $sa = 'stcontosomglab' + (Get-Random -Minimum 1000 -Maximum 9999) }

az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-code-08 -f C:\lab\pl08\infra\main.bicep -p storageAccountName=$sa principalId=$me assignRole=false -o none; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'deployment to rg-mglab-code-08 failed' }
Set-Content C:\lab\pl08\.account-url "https://$sa.blob.core.windows.net" -NoNewline

screens.name: denied
prepare: $me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
$sa = az storage account list -g rg-mglab-code-08 --query "[0].name" -o tsv
$scope = az storage account show -n $sa -g rg-mglab-code-08 --query id -o tsv
az role assignment delete --assignee $me --scope $scope
mask: storage account name and subscription name or id in every frame
never run az account show or az storage account keys list
screens.note: Needs the first deployment with assignRole=false (the per-screen prepare also removes any role left from an earlier take). The friendly 403 text only appears for AuthorizationPermissionMismatch; not verified against the real service yet.

screens.name: run
prepare: $me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
$sa = az storage account list -g rg-mglab-code-08 --query "[0].name" -o tsv
$scope = az storage account show -n $sa -g rg-mglab-code-08 --query id -o tsv
az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-code-08 -f C:\lab\pl08\infra\main.bicep -p storageAccountName=$sa principalId=$me assignRole=true -o none

$env:CONTOSO_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_URL = "https://$sa.blob.core.windows.net"; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 40; $i++) { & C:\lab\pl08\.venv\Scripts\contoso-azure.exe list *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { break }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 20 }
mask: storage account name and subscription name or id in every frame
never run az account show or az storage account keys list
screens.note: Role changes can take up to 10 minutes; the prepare waits until 'list' works. Portal follow-up (browser, account labadmin): storage account > Data storage > Containers > packs, authentication method 'Microsoft Entra user account', storage account name masked.

screens.name: rerun
mask: storage account name and subscription name or id in every frame
never run az account show or az storage account keys list
screens.note: Portal follow-up (browser, account labadmin): open IT/PR-2026-0304.json in the packs container and frame the three approvers (Alex, Sam, Taylor Demo); account name masked.

screens.name: gotchas
screens.note: No tenant needed: pure Python 3.13 on the laptop (except* needs 3.11 or newer; the laptop's default python is 3.10, so the venv uses py -3.13).

prepare_local: & (Get-PythonExe -Version 3.13) -m venv C:\lab\pl08\.venv; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'venv failed' }   # except* needs 3.11+, the laptop's python is 3.10
& C:\lab\pl08\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -q -e 'C:\lab\pl08[dev]'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'pip install failed' }
